concepts.name: Public Status Page
concepts.summary: Two-part status page: a Node backend (backend/server.js) that reports service states, and a React/Vite frontend rendering them as a service grid with a status banner. The GitHub repository is archived; the graph exists server-side only.

flows.name: Rendering Service Status
flows.summary: Frontend fetches states from backend/server.js → ServiceGrid lays out one ServiceCard per service → StatusBanner summarizes overall platform health.
